meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:
Shaadi ke liye budget mein **silk-blend, Banarasi, georgette ya art-silk saree** sabse achhi rahengi—look festive aayega aur asli silk se kaafi sasti padengi.

### Budget ke hisaab se best options

- **₹500–₹1,000:** Banarasi silk-look, jacquard Kanjeevaram-look, chiffon/georgette sarees. Meesho par wedding sarees lagbhag ₹250–₹650 se mil rahi hain.[2][3]
- **₹1,000–₹1,500:** Embroidered silk-blend ya woven-design saree—shaadi ke guest, bhabhi ya sister ke liye acchi. Libas par options lagbhag ₹759–₹1,259 tak listed hain.[5]
- **₹1,500–₹3,000:** Heavy Banarasi, Paithani-look, sequin georgette ya ready-to-wear saree—reception ke liye better.
- **₹4,000–₹6,000:** Dola silk/art silk bridal-style saree, agar aap bride ya close family member hain; kuch options ₹4,175–₹5,800 ke aas-paas listed hain.[9]

### Occasion ke liye meri recommendation

- **Main shaadi:** Maroon, bottle green, rani pink ya royal blue Banarasi/art silk  
- **Reception:** Wine, navy blue ya black georgette with sequin work  
- **Haldi:** Yellow/mustard chiffon, cotton-silk ya organza  
- **Mehendi:** Green, teal ya multicolour silk-blend  
- **Budget-friendly safest choice:** **Banarasi silk-blend saree with zari border**, ₹800–₹1,500

### Online kharidte waqt dhyan rakhein

- Product reviews mein **customer photos** zaroor dekhein.
- “Silk” likha ho to composition check karein—aksar woh **silk blend/art silk** hota hai.
- Blouse piece, saree length, return policy aur delivery date verify karein.
- Bahut sasti saree mein fabric halka ho sakta hai; ₹250–₹400 wali saree daily/family function ke liye theek, lekin main wedding ke liye ₹800+ budget rakhein.[2][4]
- Blouse stitching aur fall-pico ka ₹300–₹800 extra budget rakhein.

**Best overall pick:** ₹1,000–₹1,500 ki **wine ya bottle-green Banarasi silk-blend saree**, contrast blouse aur light jewellery ke saath—expensive dikhegi, par budget mein rahegi.
